title: Binary Search
story: The gate numbers are sorted. Halve the search each time and find a gate among a million in about twenty steps.
goal: Write binary_search(items, target) for a sorted list: return the index or -1. It must be fast: a hidden check searches half a million items.
hints: Look at the middle item. If it is too small, throw away the left half. If too big, throw away the right half.
Keep low and high markers. Loop while low <= high and move one marker past mid each time.
socratic: What do you learn by checking the middle item?
Why must you move a marker past mid, not onto it?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Binary Search”?
